A person holds a glass beaker in one hand and fills it quickly with hot water. It takes several
seconds before his hand starts to feel the heat.
Why is there this delay?
A
Glass is a poor conductor of heat.
B
Glass is a good conductor of heat.
C
Water is a poor conductor of heat.
D
Water is a good conductor of heat.

options.label: A
options.text: Glass is a poor conductor of heat.

options.label: B
options.text: Glass is a good conductor of heat.

options.label: C
options.text: Water is a poor conductor of heat.

options.label: D
options.text: Water is a good conductor of heat.
